project_name: Erdős 836: vertex counts and pairwise edge intersections in 3-chromatic intersecting uniform hypergraphs

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos836.HasCodimensionOneAvoidingWitness
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos836.HasCodimensionOneAvoidingWitness (r : Nat) : Prop :=
  fun r =>
  Exists fun n =>
    Exists fun H =>
      And (Erdos836.IsUniform r H)
        (And (Erdos836.IsIntersecting H)
          (And (Erdos836.HasChromaticNumberThree H) (Not (Erdos836.HasPairwiseIntersectionAtLeast H (HSub.hSub r 1)))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos836.vertexDegree
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos836.vertexDegree.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [DecidableEq V] (H : Finset (Finset V)) (v : V) : Nat :=
  fun {V} [DecidableEq V] H v => Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun e => Membership.mem e v) H)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos836.HasPairwiseIntersectionAtLeast
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos836.HasPairwiseIntersectionAtLeast.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [DecidableEq V] (H : Finset (Finset V)) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  fun {V} [DecidableEq V] H k =>
  Exists fun e₁ =>
    And (Membership.mem H e₁)
      (Exists fun e₂ => And (Membership.mem H e₂) (And (Ne e₁ e₂) (LE.le k (Finset.card (Inter.inter e₁ e₂)))))

core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos836.IsLinearHypergraph.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [DecidableEq V] (H : Finset (Finset V)) : Prop :=
  fun {V} [DecidableEq V] H =>
  ∀ (e₁ : Finset V),
    Membership.mem H e₁ → ∀ (e₂ : Finset V), Membership.mem H e₂ → Ne e₁ e₂ → LE.le (Finset.card (Inter.inter e₁ e₂)) 1

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos836.Erdos836LinearIntersectionConjecture
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos836.Erdos836LinearIntersectionConjecture : Prop :=
  Exists fun c =>
  And (LT.lt 0 c)
    (∀ (r : Nat),
      LE.le 2 r →
        ∀ (n : Nat) (H : Finset (Finset (Fin n))),
          Erdos836.IsUniform r H →
            Erdos836.IsIntersecting H →
              Erdos836.HasChromaticNumberThree H →
                Exists fun e₁ =>
                  And (Membership.mem H e₁)
                    (Exists fun e₂ =>
                      And (Membership.mem H e₂)
                        (And (Ne e₁ e₂) (LE.le (HMul.hMul c ↑r) ↑(Finset.card (Inter.inter e₁ e₂))))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos836.Palomar.erdos_836.parts.i
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos836.Palomar.erdos_836.parts.i :
  Iff False
    (Exists fun C =>
      And (LT.lt 0 C)
        (∀ (r : Nat),
          LE.le 2 r →
            ∀ (n : Nat) (H : Finset (Finset (Fin n))),
              Finset.IsUniform H r →
                Finset.HasHypergraphChromaticNumber H 3 →
                  Set.Intersecting (SetLike.coe H) →
                    LE.le (↑(Finset.card (Finset.biUnion H id))) (HMul.hMul C (HPow.hPow (↑r) 2))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos836.Palomar.erdos_836.parts.ii
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos836.Palomar.erdos_836.parts.ii :
  Iff True
    (Exists fun c =>
      And (LT.lt 0 c)
        (∀ (r : Nat),
          LE.le 2 r →
            ∀ (n : Nat) (H : Finset (Finset (Fin n))),
              Finset.IsUniform H r →
                Finset.HasHypergraphChromaticNumber H 3 →
                  Set.Intersecting (SetLike.coe H) →
                    Exists fun e =>
                      And (Membership.mem H e)
                        (Exists fun f =>
                          And (Membership.mem H f)
                            (And (Ne e f) (LE.le (HMul.hMul c ↑r) ↑(Finset.card (Inter.inter e f)))))))

theorem Erdos836.Palomar.exists_alon_fin_hypergraph {r : Nat} (hr : LE.le 2 r) :
  Exists fun n =>
    Exists fun H =>
      And (Erdos836.IsUniform r H)
